description.codex: Query validated onchain data with SQD Portal.
description.claude: Query validated onchain data with SQD Portal.
description.long: Use SQD Portal to inspect wallets, contracts, transfers, blocks, and market activity with read-only MCP tools. For larger jobs, switch to Portal for raw exports or Pipes SDK for durable data pipelines.

defaultPrompts: Show the last 200 BTC perp fills on Hyperliquid with price, size, side, and raw rows only.
Chart Base transaction throughput over the last 2 hours in 15-minute buckets.
Trace Base USDC flows from the past hour with amounts, counterparties, and tx hashes.

skills.name: portal
skills.purpose: Plan non-obvious SQD data work across Portal MCP, Portal exports, and Pipes SDK. Direct raw-row/export prompts should use the SQD MCP tool or Portal Stream API without loading this skill.

skills.name: pipes
skills.purpose: Turn Portal handoffs into durable Pipes SDK data pipelines when the job needs recurring sync, joins, storage, or production analytics.
